about: atlas-core domain invariants across adapter capabilities, handles, turn/request/limit, sessions/rotation, threads, subagent trees, boot reconciliation, and live cutover.

mutants.name: atlas-core-adapter-emulates-steer
mutants.rule: Adapters must never emulate unsupported steer operations when Capabilities.Steer is false.

mutants.name: atlas-core-adapter-yolo-fallback-skips-supervised
mutants.to:
case ModeYolo:
		ModeYolo
mutants.rule: Unsupported ModeYolo requests must fall back strictly to ModeSupervised rather than proceeding.

mutants.name: atlas-core-adapter-allows-unsupported-direct-agy
mutants.rule: Direct Antigravity must remain gated off unless Capabilities.OfficiallySupported is true.

mutants.name: atlas-core-continuation-drops-claude-config-dir
mutants.from:
case ClaudeMeta:
		ContinuationKey("claude:home:\(configDir)")
mutants.to:
case ClaudeMeta:
		ContinuationKey("claude:home:shared")
mutants.rule: Distinct Claude config directories must produce distinct continuation keys so accounts do not alias.

mutants.name: atlas-core-handle-delivers-routes-shell-to-registry
mutants.from:
case KindShell:
		DelivererShellHost
mutants.to:
case KindShell:
		DelivererRegistry
mutants.rule: DELIVERS maps KindShell solely to DelivererShellHost, never DelivererRegistry.

mutants.name: atlas-core-handle-handed-emits-wake
mutants.rule: DispHanded transitions a call cleanly into a child handle without emitting a wake letter.

mutants.name: atlas-core-handle-retire-owner-retires-other-owners
mutants.from: if hv.Owner == deadOwner && hv.Kind == KindCall && IsOpen(hv.Disposition) {
mutants.to: if hv.Kind == KindCall && IsOpen(hv.Disposition) {
mutants.rule: Retiring one dead owner settles only that owner's volatile KindCall handles and keeps other owners live.

mutants.name: atlas-core-turn-allows-retry-after-first-delta
mutants.rule: A turn must never retry after its first output delta has arrived.

mutants.name: atlas-core-turn-allows-finish-with-stranded-stop
mutants.rule: Dispatched turns with StopWanted set must issue a driver cancel rather than ending stranded.

mutants.name: atlas-core-turn-skips-write-approval-gate
mutants.to: let _ = true
mutants.rule: ExecuteWrite must enforce PermissionMode and ApprovalGranted via adapter.RequireWriteApproval.

mutants.name: atlas-core-request-delivers-to-dead-session
mutants.rule: Buffered interactive request answers must never be delivered to a dead or detached session.

mutants.name: atlas-core-limit-allows-overdue-24h-arm
mutants.rule: Limit recovery must refuse to arm stale resets overdue beyond 24 hours.

mutants.name: atlas-core-limit-resumes-on-expired-session
mutants.rule: Auto-resume must never fire when the session is already expired.

mutants.name: atlas-core-session-mcp-accepts-expired-token
mutants.rule: Per-thread /mcp tokens expire after 24 hours idle without a real turn touch.

mutants.name: atlas-core-rotation-switches-fixed-account
mutants.rule: Threads configured with RotationFixed must never move off their pinned account.

mutants.name: atlas-core-rotation-switches-mid-turn
mutants.rule: Account rotation must never occur while a turn is active on the thread.

mutants.name: atlas-core-thread-allows-concurrent-turns
mutants.rule: A single thread must never run two concurrent active turns.

mutants.name: atlas-core-thread-link-origin-bypasses-mcp-fence
mutants.from:
case OriginMcpScoped as scoped:
			mcp.ThreadID == scoped.BoundThread && mcp.ThreadID == t.ID
mutants.to:
case OriginMcpScoped:
			true
mutants.rule: D63 LinkOrigin fencing must reject limited /mcp callers for any thread outside their bound scope.

mutants.name: atlas-core-subagent-allows-handback-with-open-handles
mutants.rule: A subagent child must achieve zero final hand-back while still holding open handles.

mutants.name: atlas-core-subagent-allows-sibling-subtree-control
mutants.rule: Subagent control operations must stay strictly inside the caller's own descendant subtree.

mutants.name: atlas-core-reconcile-drops-live-foreign-calls
mutants.from: let isForeignLive = h.Owner != snap.BootingOwner && containsOwner(snap.LiveForeignOwners, h.Owner)
mutants.to: let isForeignLive = false
mutants.rule: BootReconcile must leave open KindCall handles owned by live peer owners untouched.

mutants.name: atlas-core-reconcile-replays-delivered-wake
mutants.from: if w.Delivered || containsString(deliveredIDs, w.DeliveryID) {
mutants.to: if false {
mutants.rule: BootReconcile must never re-deliver wakes whose immutable DeliveryID was already delivered.

mutants.name: atlas-core-cutover-allows-abort-after-commit
mutants.rule: Cutover must refuse rollback once CommitPersisted has recorded New ownership.

mutants.name: atlas-core-cutover-allows-old-act-in-transfer
mutants.from:
case CutoverTransfer, CutoverCommitted, CutoverDone:
			SplitBrainRejected{Reason: "old_fenced_in_transfer"}
mutants.to:
case CutoverTransfer, CutoverCommitted, CutoverDone:
			s
mutants.rule: Cutover must fence Old from mutating state in transfer and after commit.

mutants.name: atlas-store-idempotent-cmd-ignores-payload
mutants.rule: Reusing a committed CommandID with a different payload must fail CommandReused rather than acting as an idempotent no-op.

mutants.name: atlas-store-lease-fence-allows-stale-owner
mutants.rule: Fenced writes must fail LeaseFenced when owner, epoch, or fencing token mismatches the durable lease.

mutants.name: atlas-store-lease-fence-allows-transfer-window
mutants.rule: Fenced writes must fail LeaseFenced while the lease is in CutoverTransfer handoff.

mutants.name: atlas-store-hold-wake-before-retry-at
mutants.rule: Waiting quota PoolHolds must reject HoldActionWake prior to RetryAtMs.

mutants.name: atlas-store-pool-reset-double-claim
mutants.rule: Pool reset dispatch claims must accept at most one winner per (account, window_kind, period_key).

mutants.name: atlas-store-pool-inflight-allows-negative
mutants.to: let nextInflight = acc.InflightStarts + cmd.Delta
mutants.rule: PoolAccount.InflightStarts must never decrement below zero.

mutants.name: atlas-store-kernel-snapshot-exceeds-cap
mutants.rule: Kernel snapshots exceeding MaxKernelSnapshotBytes must be refused.

mutants.name: atlas-store-kernel-root-share-flag-dropped
mutants.from: let flagged = nextActive*int64(100) >= KernelRootSharePct()*KernelRootWindowMs()
mutants.to: let flagged = false
mutants.rule: Kernel cuts breaching the hourly root execution share threshold must flag KernelRootUsage and KernelCutJournal.

mutants.name: atlas-store-query-active-push-ignores-end-bound
mutants.rule: Time-boxed OwnerPush windows are half-open [StartsAtMs, EndsAtMs) and expire at EndsAtMs.

mutants.name: atlas-store-query-due-hold-skips-retry-equality
mutants.rule: PoolHolds become due cleanly at nowMs == RetryAtMs.

mutants.name: atlas-store-sqlite-skip-command-reused
mutants.rule: SQLite store must return CommandReused when an existing CommandID is replayed with a differing payload.

mutants.name: atlas-store-sqlite-scope-drops-lease-fence
mutants.rule: SQLite write scope loader must load the fenced lease record before calling Decide.

mutants.name: atlas-store-sqlite-schema-fence-bypass
mutants.rule: SQLite store must refuse opening databases whose schema_meta or user_version does not match CurrentSchemaVersion.

mutants.name: atlas-store-sqlite-user-version-without-meta-allowed
mutants.rule: SQLite store must refuse non-zero PRAGMA user_version databases lacking schema_meta.

mutants.name: atlas-store-sqlite-prompt-queue-skips-delete
mutants.from: let _ = try execTx("DELETE FROM prompt_queue WHERE thread_id = ?", []sql.Value{sql.Text{S: string(t.ID)}})
mutants.to: let _ = try execTx("DELETE FROM prompt_queue WHERE thread_id = ? AND 1 = 0", []sql.Value{sql.Text{S: string(t.ID)}})
mutants.rule: Thread prompt_queue projection must clear stale queue entries on rewrite to avoid phantom queued prompts.

mutants.name: atlas-store-sqlite-boot-drops-lost-wake-flag
mutants.rule: BootReconcile SQLite projection must persist wake_emitted = 1 when settling lost KindCall handles.
